brief: Three photorealistic views of the same winter courtyard from entry, diagonal and detail with shared geometry, light and materials; no crops falsely represented as distinct cameras.

intent.experience: A single home-scale planted interior is recognized consistently across three distinct vantage points.
intent.distinctAbility: Testable geometric world continuity with explicit camera positions rather than cropped single output.

references.observation: Description directly relates the courtyard to daylight, ventilation and orientation; adapted as room-scale aperture strategy.
Architectural project details natural material palette of travertine and timber in naturally lit courtyards.
Visual example inspected: planted interior atrium with raking daylight over pale floor tiles and vertical joinery.

components.role: A fixed measurable 7.20 by 6.00 by 3.40 meter courtyard
components.strategy: Procedural shared VTK 9.6 world coordinate system
components.constraints: No independent room regeneration between the three camera viewpoints.

components.role: Single olive tree rooted inside a measured limestone planter
components.strategy: Seeded branches and planting actors in shared world
components.constraints: Root, planter curb, fern locations never translate with the camera.

components.role: Three independent camera poses on shared geometry in real meter space
components.strategy: Single VTK renderer changes camera only between exports
components.constraints: No crop is counted as a new view, room coordinates stay identical.

components.role: Skylight-driven natural illumination and material continuity
components.strategy: One explicitly measured roof aperture with a fixed sun rig
components.constraints: Photometric accuracy and indirect lighting are not yet calibrated.

questions.question: What test proves these views share the same room rather than visually similar rooms?
alternatives: A single fixed-coordinate model and camera matrices
questions.finding: Older W002/02 relied on crops and lacked a reprojectable scene.
questions.decisionImpact: Build a single fixed-size scene before rendering three camera locations.

questions.question: What daylight aperture and material language produces a credible architectural patio?
alternatives: Random prompt-created glazing and sun direction
Skylight fixed in plan and one material/lighting rig
questions.finding: Published courtyard precedents position light wells and timber junctions as architectural structure.
questions.decisionImpact: Fix the same skylight/wood/stone and east glazing in all renders.

questions.question: Which visible fixed architectural objects expose a disguised change in camera versus a new scene?
alternatives: Fixed planted olive, limestone curb, oak bench and north slats
questions.finding: Observed courtyard photos preserve planted void, floor and structural landmarks.
questions.decisionImpact: Anchor physical landmarks at named metric coordinates for all views.

decisions.choice: One dimensional world with three separate camera objects
decisions.productionChange: Three 1440×960 renders from one VTK world with cameras A/B/C
decisions.why: Spatial continuity requires geometric reproducibility, not only color resemblance.

decisions.choice: Explicit skylight with shared sunlight definition
decisions.productionChange: Skylight footprint is x=2.2..5.45 and y=1.8..4.35 in source world
decisions.why: Shared openings constrain plausible sun path and architectural scale.

decisions.choice: Measured single planter and olive root, seeded leaf distribution
decisions.productionChange: Planter centered 3.65,3.05; olive root 3.64,3.02; bench west
decisions.why: Persistent landmarks make impossible spatial changes more visible.

relations.invariant: All camera views use the exact same floor, walls, openings and furniture objects.
relations.failure: One viewpoint silently creates a different room with similar surfaces.
relations.test: Single process scene render, distinct camera poses, constant scene manifest.

relations.invariant: Olive root, planter walls and fern distribution never change global coordinates.
relations.failure: Tree appears at a new place when viewpoint changes.
relations.test: Compare anchored positions and floorplan in all frames.

risks.failure: One generated picture cannot be projected into the model, while follow-up became unrelated art.
risks.prevention: Reject unrelated result; switch to an explicit metric world before multiplying views.
risks.test: Three photoreal cameras must render from one scene and preserve specific landmarks.

acceptance.criterion: A genuine architectural photo first article depicts patio, opening, grounded tree and natural material.
acceptance.oracle: Inspect actual 1536×1024 raster at original resolution.

acceptance.criterion: Three different camera matrices all project a single fixed-coordinate model.
acceptance.oracle: Inspect plan and three independent VTK renderer camera outputs.

acceptance.criterion: Three consistent photorealistic finished images from the same rig are delivered.
acceptance.oracle: Image inspection and geometric landmark projection across all photoreal cameras.

acceptance.criterion: Opening mobile 390 and desktop 1440 screenshots show the art without intrusive UI.
acceptance.oracle: Actual browser screenshots at both widths with frame inspection.

licensing: Newly created photo and author-created procedural 3D; professional reference images used only for research.
resources: Image generation first article; local Python3/Pillow and VTK 9.6 EGL for deterministic scene and three render previews.
environmentLimits: Three photoreal independent cameras not achieved; source render stays CAD-like. Public asset upload from container to GitHub unavailable; original media downloadable in chat ZIP.

artDirection.flowRef: Shared Q-LOOP QBAR-1 DEEP-SPEC-1, specialist private flow unverified

promise.subject: A single contemporary domestic patio photographed from three coherent angles
promise.intent: The human recognizes one serene real architectural space and one stable sun direction

benchmark.description: Observed original architecture photo; single planted void, timber and stone junctions and daylight footprint.

techniques.viability: First original raster exists; second generated raster failed the subject altogether.
techniques.license: Newly generated original image, architectural reference pictures not copied.

techniques.family: Metric VTK 3D scene with independent cameras
techniques.viability: Software and renderer executed three real camera images from one common model.
techniques.license: Original procedural geometry and locally generated outputs.

firstFrame.openingDescription: Architecture is the content; full-bleed atrium with a living olive under rooflight.
firstFrame.focalSubject: Olive tree and limestone inset planter, floor and glazing tell scale.
firstFrame.minimalUI: No added UI controls on any image; QA kept separately.

checks.criterion: At 390 the tree and roof opening fit
At 1440 lighting and scale remain legible

firstArticle.target: Genuine photo first article and a matching second camera perspective
firstArticle.rejectWhen: A new image changes to an unrelated topic or cannot match its world
firstArticle.switchTo: Metric VTK 3D scene with independent cameras
firstArticle.oracle: Reject if the resulting image is not a matching architectural courtyard
firstArticle.resourceProof: Original photo 1536×1024 and three VTK camera renders 1440×960 exist locally
firstArticle.reason: Second generative output depicted the PROMETEO arena, not a courtyard.
